title: Avenger broccoli (Avenger F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Avenger broccoli is an F1 hybrid broccoli variety from Allied Botanical. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Avenger broccoli is an F1 hybrid broccoli variety, also sold or known as Avenger F1. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical.

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Avenger broccoli is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Avenger F1, this is the same broccoli. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [broccoli variety finder](/crop-varieties/broccoli), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources
rows: Days to harvest, per the seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit broccoli fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [black rot of cabbage](/diseases/black-rot), [cabbage webworm](/pests/cabbage-webworm), [clubroot](/diseases/clubroot), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** 60 to 65 days after transplanting.
**Fruit:** Head: compact and very heavy, fine beads, 650 to 700 g.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: allied Botanical's all season highland broccoli, the only evidence found is Allied's listing. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual broccoli on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Avenger broccoli
Broccoli is a cool weather crop for the highlands. Pick a variety with a tight, even head. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Avenger F1 the same as Avenger?
items.a: Yes. Avenger F1 is another name for Avenger. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Avenger?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
